title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 79
paragraphs: He had some deserters with him, and by questioning them he got the names he needed. He then sent a herald to summon out the Argives shut up in the sanctuary, calling each one by name and saying that their ransom had already been paid. (Among the Peloponnesians the standard ransom is fixed at two minae of silver per prisoner.) One by one Cleomenes called about fifty Argives out and put them to death. For some time those still inside the enclosure did not notice what was happening — the grove was dense, and those inside could not see what was going on outside — until one of them climbed a tree and saw from above what was being done. After that, they would not come out when they were called.
